raw.details:
Event Details

  • Format: Hybrid — 9-day development period followed by presentations at Concetto.
  • Registration deadline: 28 September 2026
  • Game Jam: 29 September – 7 October 2026
  • Submission deadline: 7 October 2026
  • Results: Concetto Day 3
  • Final presentation: 3-minute presentation + 2-minute Q&A at Concetto. Offline presentation is primary; an online option is available only if a team is unable to attend physically.

Participation & Teams

  • Each team may have a maximum of 3 members.
  • Participants may use any game engine or framework, including Unity, Unreal, Godot, etc.
  • Remote development is allowed during the development period.

Game Development Rules

  • The theme will be revealed on 29 September 2026. Every submitted game must follow the announced theme.
  • The core mechanics of the game must be developed by the participating team.
  • Pre-made complete game systems or complete games may not be submitted as original work.
  • External assets are allowed, provided the team has the proper rights to use them and gives appropriate credits.

Submission Requirements

  • Submit the final game through the designated Google Drive submission link before the deadline.
  • Submission should include: playable game build, gameplay video, PPT/presentation, and any required extra files.
  • Late or incomplete submissions may not be considered for evaluation.

Evaluation

  • Games will be evaluated on creativity, gameplay, theme implementation, originality, and overall presentation.
  • The judges' decision will be final.

General Rules

  • Plagiarism or misrepresentation of another person's work is strictly prohibited and may result in disqualification.
  • Participants must follow the instructions of the organisers throughout the event.
  • The organisers reserve the right to disqualify a team for rule violations or misconduct.
  • By participating, teams agree to the rules and decisions of the organisers and judges.

Prizes

  • 1st Prize: ₹12,000
  • 2nd Prize: ₹8,000
  • 3rd Prize: ₹5,000
